summary_md: **Arnaud Mercier - #Entrepreneur #Versailles ([@arnaudmercier](https://x.com/arnaudmercier/status/2115724756276167023))** shares **BiPA** ([arXiv 2610.37201](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.37201v1)), which questions whether generalist skill optimizers actually help long-horizon agentic tasks and proposes bipartite attribution to tell which skill edits really drive gains, with code at [valleysprings/BiPA](https://github.com/valleysprings/BiPA.git).

referenced_urls.title: Does Your Generalist Skill Optimizer Really Incentivize Agentic Tasks?Rethinking Skill Optimization via Bipartite Attribution

relevance: Rigorous look at whether agent-skill optimization works.
